$comment: specify-capability-rows 11.1 (row work-recurring-task): a task with a repeat schedule comes back on that schedule. A task may repeat every day, week or month; when its due date comes, the scheduled task job (TaskRecurrence) makes the next occurrence, due one interval on, and links the two through nextOccurrence / previousOccurrence so it is made once. Sorted after every other crmTask fragment so the version it stamps is the merged one: crmTask 1.2.1 -> 1.3.0. Additive, optional.

repeat.title: Repeat
repeat.description: How often the task comes back. When it is due, the next one is made, due one interval later.

nextOccurrence.title: Next occurrence
nextOccurrence.description: The task made when this repeating task came due.

previousOccurrence.title: Previous occurrence
previousOccurrence.description: The repeating task this task was made from.
